What We Design

Eight connected parts turn a shop floor into a clear, memorable buying journey.

01

Store Layout Planning

Customer routes, product zones and staff movement are resolved around the floor.

02

Product Display & Shelving

Displays make products easy to notice, compare and reach.

03

Brand Styling & Graphics

Colour, materials and graphics carry one recognisable store identity.

04

Retail Lighting Design

Ambient and accent light reveal product colour, texture and detail.

05

Checkout & Billing Counter

The final customer touchpoint is planned for smooth queues and staff workflow.

06

Trial Room Design

Privacy, mirrors, seating and flattering light create an easy fitting experience.

07

Facade & Signage

A clear shopfront and visible signage help the store stand out.

08

Storage & Stockroom

Back-of-house storage supports quick replenishment without crowding the floor.

01 / 08

Our Design Process

Five focused stages take the store from brief to an approved design package.

01

Consultation & Requirements

We define the product mix, customer, brand direction, budget and programme.

02

Site Measurement

We record the floor, services, frontage, access and existing conditions.

03

Concept & Layout Design

Customer flow, product zones, displays and checkout are tested together.

04

Material & Furniture Selection

Durable finishes, shelving, counters and lighting are coordinated.

05

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

Approved 3D views and drawings prepare the store for pricing and execution.

Pricing

The initial consultation and site survey are free. Your exact fixed quote follows the survey, once the size and display requirements are clear.
